message:
No tests ran in the emulation: zero checks ran and none passed, so the design is not validated yet. The empty failures list doesn't mean it is correct. It was blocked because none of the eight Azure services we drew has a generator implementation yet. The only Azure option today is plain private storage, and reducing the design to that would drop most of what you asked for. So this is engineering work on the product, not something we fix by redrawing. The steps to reproduce it are: design revision 2, artifact 214ec933…, and the blocker list. The simulator is also flagged because it is an existing system that needs a reference plan.

While that work waits, let's settle the decision your acceptance criteria depend on. Once that engineering exists, late and out-of-order readings are the first behaviour a real test can check. How late can a reading arrive, measured by the device's own timestamp (for example 5 minutes), and should anything later be scored and marked late, or set aside in quarantine?
